data.one_liner: Zero-overhead native FFI bindings and runtime layer for Flutter plugins
data.what_it_does: Nitro provides the base classes, annotations, and runtime primitives for writing type-safe, zero-copy FFI plugins across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web with no method-channel overhead. It supports synchronous calls, async isolate dispatch, native streams, and zero-copy structs.
use_when: You are authoring high-performance native plugins for Flutter using FFI
You need zero-copy data transfer between Dart and native memory (like camera frames or audio)
You want type-safe native module bridges without manual boilerplate or method channel overhead
avoid_when: You are building a standard app developer project and not developing a Nitrogen-powered native plugin
Your project does not require native FFI modules and standard method channels suffice
strengths: Type-safe generated bridges for Swift, Kotlin, and C++
Zero-copy buffer support via @HybridStruct and NitroBuffer
Automatic and adaptive worker pool for async calls
weaknesses: Requires using the separate code generator and CLI tooling
Requires writing native implementations in Swift, Kotlin, or C++
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up nitrogen tooling, native implementation code for each target platform, and correct minimum platform versions (such as iOS 13+ and Android NDK 26.1+).
